_readme: Linked Events instances, for mapsee_ingest_linkedevents.py. Read that file's
header first: the eleven things it documents are why this config has the
switches it has.
A DOCUMENTED PUBLIC API under CC BY 4.0 (OpenAPI at
https://api.hel.fi/linkedevents/api-docs/schema/; Espoo's fork states the same
licence at its API root). The attribution each row carries is the term the
data is held on, not a footer.
VERIFIED 2026-10-03 by running the adapter itself with the production
User-Agent, 90-day window, 1 request/second:
Helsinki  12,575 leaf rows read   8,575 kept   142 requests   311 s
Espoo      6,149 leaf rows read   1,954 kept    68 requests   105 s
10,529 rows, every one with the city's own coordinate, 90.0% free by the
publisher's is_free. Espoo keeps a third of what it publishes because 3,691
of its rows are hobby-catalogue groups and 277 more carry a sign-up form.
drop_data_sources is per instance and says why below. drop_locations names a
place whose own calendar another adapter already ingests, so its rows are not
shown twice. Measured against every Helsinki-area entry in jsonld_sources.json,
tribe_sources.json and ics_sources.json on 2026-10-03: the 11 Tribe calendars
published 219 upcoming events and 1 had a Linked Events row with the same
title and day (at another venue); one Tribe venue IS a Linked Events place
(Kalasataman Vapaakaupungin Olohuone, 2 rows), and that place is dropped here.
Five jsonld entries point at single espoo.fi event pages for places this
adapter covers in full (Sellon kirjasto alone is 401 rows); each read one
September event and 0 upcoming rows, so nothing is doubled there, and they
are not excluded here - they should be retired from jsonld_sources.json.
keep_card_holder_rows (false): Helsinki's senior and service centres run
1,586 rows for service-centre card holders only (Helsinki pensioners and
unemployed people; the card is issued at the front desk). They are out
because they are not open to anyone; true keeps them, saying who may come
and never calling them free.

instances.name: Helsinki
instances.attribution: Event data: City of Helsinki Linked Events, CC BY 4.0.

drop_locations.tprek:76754: Kalasataman Vapaakaupungin Olohuone - its own Tribe calendar (tribe_sources.json, vapaakaupunki.fi) is ingested

_drop_data_sources_why.lippupiste: Lippupiste is a ticket reseller re-publishing theatre and concert runs (309 leaf rows on 2026-10-03); the venues publish their own programme and none of it is community-centre drop-in.
_drop_data_sources_why.espoo_le: A mirror of Espoo's own instance (below): all 1,548 espoo_le rows on 2026-10-03 had a twin there by title and day, and the mirror drops the two fields that say a row is a sign-up (106 of the 1,548 carry a sign-up link in Espoo, 59 are hobby-catalogue groups).

instances.name: Espoo
instances.attribution: Event data: City of Espoo (Espoo Events, a Linked Events API), CC BY 4.0.
instances._api_host_why: api.espoo.fi/events/v1 answers too, but links every page through this backend host, and api.espoo.fi/robots.txt is unreachable (RFC 9309: assume Disallow) while this host has no robots.txt at all (an HTML page). So the host the pages are actually served from is the one configured.
